positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Full-stack development of high-performance cybersecurity and networking systems, architecting solutions across the entire software lifecycle. Championed secure coding practices, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines while delivering software to address constantly evolving cybersecurity threats.
● Collaborated on the design and implementation of highly performant artificial intelligence systems to improve detection of malicious internet traffic, significantly improving both speed and accuracy of detection, notably improving the effectiveness of the product.
● Leveraged deep knowledge of Python to write clean, readable, and maintainable code for diverse applications. Improved the effectiveness of software systems by utilizing advanced design patterns such as MVC.
● Implemented low-level data structures and algorithms in C to optimize performance-critical features. Focused on efficiency, scalability, and maintainability while ensuring the software could handle demanding workloads and meet stringent performance requirements.
● Utilized Git for version control and worked extensively in Linux environments. Reduced technical debt by
writing clean and concise documentation.

positions.title: Data Structures TA
positions.description:
● Evaluated and graded assignments, quizzes, and exams with a 48-hour turnaround, ensuring timely feedback for over 100 students
● Provided in-depth code reviews and troubleshooting support, delivering tailored guidance to help students resolve complex programming issues and improve their technical skills

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description:
● Conducted machine learning research on self-driving vehicles, focusing on optimizing braking algorithms to enhance vehicle safety using large-scale datasets and physics modeling.
● Developed and processed complex data pipelines and utilized Python libraries such as PyTorch.
● Gained in-depth research experience by engaging in experimental design, collaborative problem-solving, and iterative refinement of machine learning models, providing valuable insights into the research process and methodologies.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Machine Learning and +2 skills

projects.title: Cathedral Machine Learning Model
projects.description:
● Implemented a state of the art Monte-Carlo Search Tree (MCTS) Machine Learning Algorithm specifically designed and fine-tuned to master the complex strategy and decision making of  the board game Cathedral
● Developed the Cathedral game from scratch in Python, implementing intricate game mechanics and multiple different rulesets, providing a visual representation for user interaction
● Executed comprehensive testing to rigorously evaluate the performance and robustness of the machine learning algorithm, informing future research into the game. 
● Wrote a detailed, fully-sourced, research-backed paper that meticulously documents the use of the algorithm, the implementation of game mechanics, and the results of testing, as well as providing suggestions for future research.

projects.title: Malware Generation with Large Language Models (Honors Thesis)
projects.description:
● Architected and developed an innovative research and red-teaming tool that automates generation of malware executables from simple text descriptions, leveraging code generated by Large Language Models (LLMs).
 ● Conducted in-depth research into red-teaming and jailbreaking LLMs such as ChatGPT and Google Gemini, utilizing novel and sophisticated techniques to attempt to deceive models, informing future security and AI-alignment efforts.
 ● Harnessed a suite of AI and machine learning technologies and Python libraries, including PyTorch, to deploy, fine-tune, and test complex models. 
 ● Authored a comprehensive and thoroughly detailed research paper explaining my methodologies, citing past research, and giving insight into the design and code of the innovative research tool.
